business_purpose: Target younger and older customers differently
justification: Age has near-zero linear correlation with deposit (0.04) but a U-shaped response (60% under 30, 41-44% for 30-59, 77% for 60+). A band captures what a straight-line measure misses.
interpretation: Under-30 and 60+ are the responsive ages.

business_purpose: Gauge financial capacity at a glance
justification: Raw balance is extremely skewed (8.3); tiers give stable groups and an easy rule for call lists.

business_purpose: Make balance usable in correlations and averages
justification: Reduces skew so a few large accounts do not dominate statistics.
interpretation: Compare balances on a ratio-like scale.

business_purpose: Summarise debt burden in one field
justification: Two yes/no columns carry one idea (debt load); response falls from 59.6% (no loans) to 31.7% (both).
interpretation: Any loan lowers response; both lowest.

justification: Response drops from 53% (1 call) to 29% (6+); bands show where returns fade.
pdays = -1 is a code, not a number; averaging it is meaningless. A flag uses it correctly.
91% of previous successes subscribe again; the flag makes the group easy to extract.

business_purpose: Flag records with missing channel information
justification: Unknown-channel customers respond at 24% vs 54% cellular; the gap may be a data-capture issue.
Months are noisy and uneven; quarters give larger groups.
Customers may be more receptive near pay-days; included to test, evaluated honestly in section 6.

business_purpose: Describe call quality after the call
justification: Strongest single signal (9% under 2 min vs 85% over 10) but known only AFTER the call, so NOT usable for choosing whom to call.
